preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some MVK tokens to initiate the attack
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true and contract must have accumulated enough tokens from fees to trigger swapAndLiquify
Attacker must not be blocked (checkUserBlocked[attacker] = false) and must meet sell eligibility requirements

exploit_hint: Create a malicious contract with a fallback/receive function that re-enters the vulnerable contract during the external call in swapAndLiquify. The attack should: 1) Ensure the contract has accumulated fee tokens (by making normal trades). 2) Trigger swapAndLiquify by selling tokens to the pair. 3) During the marketingwallet.transfer() call in swapAndLiquify, re-enter the contract via the receive() function to claim rewards multiple times before state updates. 4) Alternatively, re-enter during pancakeRouter.addLiquidityETH call. The key is to exploit the lack of reentrancy guards during external calls while the contract is in an inconsistent state.
